model.costScope: Full annual gross recognized recipient expense, including donated supplies once. Not a verified audited resource total or marginal unrestricted-donation cost. All material recipient health pathways are in decision scope, but the historical numerical diagnostics quantify only a conditional overdose-survival pathway.
model.geographicAttribution: Historical g=.65 is an unmeasured prior, not the beta central. The pinned NYC MSA includes Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Monmouth, Morris, Ocean, Passaic, Somerset, Sussex and Union in New Jersey. Rescued beneficiary residence, rather than supply delivery location, is required. No whole-state or CSA attribution.
model.formula: Historical diagnostics only: U=C*f/k; delta=e*t*l; dlog=ln(1+d); F(v,t)=(1-exp(-v*t))/v; H=U*u*[F(m-delta+dlog,1)-F(m+dlog,1)+(exp(-(m-delta))-exp(-m))*exp(-dlog)*F(m+dlog,T-1)]; Qall=b*H-h; QMSA=g*Qall. Cost sensitivities change numerator only. The encounter-level mortality input l is mapped linearly into a hazard decrement delta=e*t*l as an approximation, not an exact probability-to-hazard identity. With h=0 and numeratorCostUSD=C, C cancels from price. Unobserved f/k generates the output denominator; accounting revaluation must not be interpreted as physical added reach.
model.counterfactual: State naloxone procurement, pharmacy access, other community distributors and emergency response continue. t credits only additional timely rescue beyond those alternatives. An ordinary gift does not buy all donated stock anew.
model.attribution: f allocates an assumed capacity share, k turns that share into unique risk-person years, e*t*l gives a one-year mortality hazard difference, and b applies funding response once. No separately multiplied repeat-rescue lifetime or national affiliate credit.
model.uncertainty: Whole-recipient central withdrawn. Actual unique reach, additional timely rescue, funded capacity, victim residence and material non-overdose outcomes are unidentified. Legacy priors remain explicit historical diagnostics; no calibrated uncertainty distribution or guaranteed lower bound is available.
model.nativeOutcomes: The provider reported more than 10,000 doses and at least 140 reversal events by November 20, 2023. These are neither a current full-year unique cohort nor causal deaths averted. Supply recipient, overdose witness, repeat event and unique survivor are distinct units.
